name: Alder Circle
tagline: One orbit for everyone caring for the people who raised us.
positioning: Alder Circle turns the chaos of caring for an aging parent into a single, calm command center your whole family can actually run.

hero.h1: The command center for caring for the people who raised you.
hero.sub: Medications, appointments, aides, and siblings — one shared orbit that keeps every caregiver on the same page, at 2pm and at 2am. This is the future of the family, coordinated.

features.title: The living care timeline
features.description: Every dose, doctor's note, and fall lands on one timeline the whole family sees in real time. No more 40-message group chats reconstructing what happened Tuesday.

features.title: Handoffs that never drop
features.description: When the day aide leaves and your sister takes over, the shift notes, meds, and mood pass cleanly. Nothing falls through the cracks between caregivers again.

features.title: Medication radar
features.description: Track prescriptions, refills, and interactions in one place. Alder Circle pings the right person before a bottle runs empty — not after.

features.title: The whole circle, roles and all
features.description: Invite siblings, aides, and Mom's neighbor with exactly the permissions each should have. Everyone contributes; nobody sees more than they need.

features.title: Documents, finally findable
features.description: Insurance cards, the DNR, the pharmacy number, the WiFi password for the aide. Every vital artifact lives one tap away for the person who needs it.

features.title: Privacy worthy of family
features.description: Health details are encrypted and access is logged. We treat your parent's record with the gravity it deserves.

testimonials.quote: I have three siblings in three time zones and a mother with early Alzheimer's. Alder Circle is the first thing that made us feel like one team instead of four people guessing. It genuinely gave me back my evenings.
testimonials.name: Priya Raghavan

testimonials.quote: We manage aides for eleven families now, and the shift handoff notes alone eliminated the frantic morning phone calls. Every caregiver walks in already knowing the night before.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: After Dad's second hospitalization I stopped keeping his meds in my head and started keeping them in Alder Circle. When the ER asked what he was taking, I turned my phone around. That moment sold me.
testimonials.name: Marcus Bell

pricing.blurb: For one person quietly holding it all together.
For the whole family running care as a team.
For complex care with professional help in the loop.

homepage.footerBlurb: Alder Circle is the shared orbit for family caregiving — one calm place for the whole circle to keep the people who raised us safe, seen, and well.
